title_original: Paris – Là où le sol pousse
excerpt_original: From November 25th to December 23rd, 2026, “Where the Soil Grows” brings together artists, scientists, photographers, writers, and researchers in Paris 261 Boulevard Raspail […] Cet article Paris – Là où le sol pousse est apparu en premier sur The Eye of Photography Magazine .

blocks.text: From November 25th to December 23rd, 2026, “Where the Soil Grows” brings together artists, scientists, photographers, writers, and researchers in Paris 261 Boulevard Raspail to explore a common subject—one that is both familiar and little known: THE SOIL, with which we form a single, terrestrial community.

Drawing on five types of terrain—agricultural, vinicultural, forested, volcanic, and urban—“Where the Soil Grows” reveals what lies beneath the surface: the symbiotic relationships between roots, fungi, and bacteria, without which no soil would be fertile—a living substance that also bears the traces of our human activities.
Photographs, installations, and auditory and olfactory experiences come together to create a sensory journey between art and science, from the surface to the depths of the earth.
